title: Make Blingtron 4000
zone: Profession trainer, materials and crafting interface

gaps: Fresh/returning prerequisite coverage is not established as complete.
Profession learning and skill-up before the required expansion tier/skill are outside this authored checkpoint.

nodes.text: Open the required profession and its expansion tier. Clear recipe filters, select Blingtron 4000 and let Toybox read the actual learned recipe. If this character lacks the tier or required skill, follow a supported prerequisite route or choose another activity.

recovery.text: Refresh the actual profession, recipe and inventory. Continue or Skip moves the guide cursor only; it never creates learned recipes, materials or toy ownership.

nodes.text: Visit the recorded trainer and inspect the offered Blingtron 4000 recipe. Select the correct expansion profession tier and learn this exact offered recipe yourself. Review the actual training cost and skill restriction before paying.

recovery.text: Refresh the actual profession, recipe and inventory. Continue or Skip moves the guide cursor only; it never creates learned recipes, materials or toy ownership.

details.costPolicy: The live trainer offer is authoritative; no price or eligibility is inferred from base profession presence.

nodes.text: Confirm that this exact recipe is learned in the selected profession tier. A profession category or character level alone does not establish recipe access.

nodes.text: Prepare the recipe’s required materials: 4 Living Steel, 4 Trillium Bar, 4 Ghost Iron Bar, 4 Vermilion Onyx, 4 Wild Jade, 4 Spirit of Harmony. These quantities describe one representative quality selection. Use any alternative quality the live recipe accepts; do not add every quality rank together. Reserve each material once across planned crafts. Review missing inputs before spending.

recovery.text: Refresh the actual profession, recipe and inventory. Continue or Skip moves the guide cursor only; it never creates learned recipes, materials or toy ownership.

Compare current quantities and prices, make only purchases you choose, then collect deliveries. Continue after inspecting the actual recipe again; a different accepted quality need not match the representative item ID.

details.destinationPolicy: This is optional procurement. Skip it when materials are already held. No listing stock, price or purchase is assumed.

nodes.text: Bring the compatible tools listed by the live recipe: Arclight Spanner, Blacksmith Hammer. An already owned compatible substitute counts; do not buy duplicate tools just because a reference item ID differs.

details.destinationPolicy: Inspect this exact recipe and your profession equipment. Tradable compatible tools can use the same optional AH procurement route; bound tools require their own crafting source.

nodes.text: Review the selected recipe, tools and actual reagent slots, then craft Blingtron 4000 yourself. Crafting uses only the player’s chosen materials and never creates ownership in saved observations.

recovery.text: If the game refuses the craft, read its actual missing tier, skill, specialization, tool or reagent restriction and return to the relevant preparation step. Do not infer craftability from recipe knowledge alone.

nodes.text: Use Blingtron 4000 from your bags yourself. Wait for the Toy Box to report ownership; crafting and item receipt are separate from learning.

recovery.text: If the item is missing, check inventory, bank and mail. If the game blocks learning, inspect its actual profession or item restriction. The guide does not mark the toy owned from a completed craft.
